note: Every Gitleaks rule maps the same way. A hit in a tracked file or in history fails SEC-SECRETS-004. A hit in a file that matches client_code_paths also fails SEC-SECRETS-001, whether tracked or not, because that is where a secret reaches the browser or the app package. A hit in an untracked file outside those paths is kept as an unmapped observation: it is on this machine, not in the repository.
